cards.audioText: Your call sign is KLM88, you are at Pudong Airport, stand 223, you are fully ready, call Shanghai delivery and request ATC clearance to Amsterdam.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是荷航88，你现在浦东机场，223号停机位，你现在准备好了，呼叫上海放行，申请管制许可，目的地阿姆斯特丹。
cards.referenceText: Pudong Delivery, KLM88, stand 223, request ATC clearance to Amsterdam.
cards.referenceTextZh: 浦东放行，荷航88，223号机位，请求放行许可，目的地阿姆斯特丹。

cards.audioText: KLM88, Shanghai Delivery. Cleared to destination via flight planned route, use runway 35, LAK-05D departure, initial climb to 1500m, cruising level 11000m, squawk 3512.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，可以经由计划航路飞往目的地，跑道35，LAK-05D离场，初始爬升至1500米，巡航高度11000米，应答机3512。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to destination via flight planned route, runway 35, LAK-05D departure, initial climb to 1500m, cruising level 11000m, squawk 3512, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往目的地，跑道35，LAK-05D离场，初始爬升至1500米，巡航高度11000米，应答机3512，荷航88。

cards.audioText: KLM88, readback correct, contact 118.9 when ready for pushback and startup.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，复诵正确，准备好推出开车叫118.9。
cards.referenceText: Contact 118.9 when ready, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 准备好时叫118.9，荷航88。

cards.audioText: Tell Ground controller, passenger boarding is not completed, You have to wait for 15 minutes before you can pushback and startup
cards.audioTextZh: 跟地面说你还要再等15分钟才能推出开车，乘客登机还没完成。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, KLM88, request 15 minutes delay due boarding not completed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，荷航88，由于登机未完成，请求15分钟延误。

cards.audioText:
Roger delay, KLM88, call me when ready.
[You are fully ready, now call Ground, request pushback and startup.]
cards.audioTextZh:
收到，有延误，荷航88，准备好叫。
你现在准备好了，呼叫地面，请求推出开车。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, KLM88, stand 223, request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，荷航88，223号停机位，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: KLM88, pushback approved, facing east, startup at own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，同意推出，开车自行掌握，机头朝东。
cards.referenceText: Pushback approved, facing east, startup at own discretion, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出，开车自行掌握，机头朝东，荷航88。

cards.audioText: You have completed pushback and startup, request taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: [你完成了推出开车，请求滑行指令。]
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, KLM88, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，荷航88，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: KLM88, taxi via taxiway Z, Z4, A2, E2 and M1 to the holding point of runway 35, taxi with caution due workmen near taxiway Z.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，经由Z，Z4，A2，E2，M1，滑行至35跑道等待点，谨慎滑行，滑行道Z附近有工人。
cards.referenceText: Roger. Taxi via taxiway Z, Z4, A2, E2, M1 to the holding point of runway 35, thanks, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由Z，Z4，A2，E2，M1滑行至35跑道外等待点，谢谢，荷航88。

cards.audioText: Now you have reached the holding point of runway 35, you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在到达了35号跑道等待点，你准备好起飞了。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Tower, KLM88, holding point of runway 35, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海塔台，荷航88，跑道35等待点，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: KLM88, Shanghai Tower, cleared for takeoff, runway 35, keep runway heading until 900m, contact Departure on 128.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，上海塔台，可以起飞，跑道35，保持跑道航向直到900米，联系离场128.35。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, runway 35, runway heading until 900m, contact departure 128.35, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道35，跑道航向直到900米，联系离场128.35，荷航88。

cards.audioText: During climb, you found your generators have failed, and you are flying with aircraft battery, report this situation to Shanghai Departure, tell them you need to return.
cards.audioTextZh: 在爬升过程中，你发现你的发电机故障了，现在靠电池供电，报告该情况，并请求返场。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Departure, KLM88, we are flying with aircraft battery, our generators failed, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海离场，荷航88，发电机故障了，现在靠电池供电，请求返场。

cards.audioText: KLM88, Shanghai Departure, roger, expect ILS approach runway 35.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，上海离场，收到，预计使用35号跑道，盲降进近。
cards.referenceText: Expect ILS approach runway 35, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计盲降进近，35号跑道，荷航88。

cards.audioText:
KLM88, previous pilot reported the ILS signal for runway 35 is very unstable, are you able to make a second approach to another runway 36L?
[Tell controller, you are unable to do that, you don't have enough electrical power left for a second approach]
cards.audioTextZh:
荷航88，前机报告跑道35盲降信号不稳定，你可以使用另外一条跑道36左吗？
[告诉管制员，你无法照办，没有足够的电力进行第二次进近。]
cards.referenceText: Negative, unable due power not enough, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不行，我电力不足，无法照办，荷航88。

cards.audioText: KLM88, visual approach, continue descent, runway 35, you are number one, report airfield in sight.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，目视进近，继续下降，跑道35，你是第一个，机场可见报告。
cards.referenceText: No.1, visual approach, continue descent, runway 35, wilco, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 第一个，目视进近，继续下降，跑道35，照办，荷航88。

cards.audioText: You are joining downwind of runway 35, tell Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你正在加入跑道35的三边，告诉进近。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Approach, KLM88, joining downwind of runway 35.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海进近，荷航88，正在加入跑道35的三边。

cards.audioText: KLM88, roger, report on final.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，荷航88，五边报。
cards.referenceText: Report final, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 五边报，荷航88。

cards.audioText: KLM88, now establish contact with Tower 128.9.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，现在联系塔台128.9。

cards.audioText: KLM88, Shanghai Tower, you are cleared to land, surface wind 330, 2 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，上海塔台，可以落地，地面风330，2米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, runway 35, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，跑道35，荷航88。

cards.audioText: During landing, your aircraft skidded off the runway, tell Tower you are unable to taxi back by yourself.
cards.audioTextZh: 落地的时候，你的飞机偏出跑道，告诉塔台你无法靠自己滑回了。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Tower, KLM88, my aircraft skidded off the runway, unable to taxi back with my own power.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海塔台，荷航88，飞机偏出跑道，无法自行滑回。

cards.audioText:
Report your intention, KLM88.
[Tell ATC, that you need shuttle bus to disembark passengers and a tug to tow you back to apron.]
cards.audioTextZh:
报告你的意图，荷航88。
告诉管制，你需要摆渡车让乘客下飞机以及拖车拖你回机坪。
cards.referenceText: Request shuttle bus to disembark passengers and a tug to tow us back to apron, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求摆渡车让乘客下飞机，以及拖车拖飞机回机坪，荷航88。

cards.audioText: Roger, KLM88, emergency services will be ready soon.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，荷航88，马上准备应急救援。
cards.referenceText: Thanks, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 感谢，荷航88。
